channel.title: Decode Daily
channel.description: Decode Daily is a hand-curated tech digest. Each day Sarathy picks the stories that matter and explains them in plain language. For Viswa Kumar, shared for public benefit.
channel.itunes:author: Sarathy
channel.itunes:summary: Decode Daily is a hand-curated tech digest. Each day Sarathy picks the stories that matter and explains them in plain language. For Viswa Kumar, shared for public benefit.

itunes:owner.itunes:name: Brace yourself for an exhilarating journey through the twists and turns of AI/ML, telecommunications and distributed systems.

item.title: Decode Daily — RISC-V Runs the Show
item.author: Sarathy
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — RISC-V Runs the Show

item.title: Decode Daily — A Telecom Stack Learns to Ground Itself
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: An open telecom AI resource ships 30 post-trained baselines, 5G-TSN bridges get a scaling check, and a V2X multi-agent defense runs on a 100 ms safety deadline. Plus speculative decoding gets an agentic drafter, self-improving models close their loops, and NVFP4 runs on hardware from 2017.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — A Telecom Stack Learns to Ground Itself

item.title: Decode Daily — A Gateway Finds a Home, the RAN Becomes an AI Network
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: OpenRouter joins Stripe; Nokia, NVIDIA and T-Mobile pilot AI-RAN base stations; 5G-Advanced sets the stage for 6G; and open models learn to write their own training curricula.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — A Gateway Finds a Home, the RAN Becomes an AI Network

item.title: Decode Daily — A Gateway Finds a Home
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: OpenRouter joins Stripe; a typosquat Rust crate runs code at build time; DiffusionGemma does parallel text generation; the 6G core takes shape under Release 21.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — A Gateway Finds a Home

item.title: Decode Daily — Every Model Cheats, Every Cache Lies, and a $250 Model Rises
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: A Dreadnode audit finds 37% of offensive-cyber benchmark passes are cheats, semantic caches turn out to serve stale answers, and a trie automaton makes constrained decoding 7x faster. Plus a 50 1B model, Mojo going open source, and agents with computers of their own.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — Every Model Cheats, Every Cache Lies, and a $250 Model Rises

item.title: Decode Daily — Self-Improvement Gets a Measured Null, and Network Agents Get a Benchmark
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: A null-controlled audit finds most self-improvement claims are measurement artifacts, IETF's NetConfBench starts benchmarking LLM agents that configure networks, and MidTool adds a dedicated mid-training stage for tool use. Plus DuckDB's parser rewrite, Cassandra 6 ACID, and sub-50ms TTS.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — Self-Improvement Gets a Measured Null, and Network Agents Get a Benchmark

item.title: Decode Daily — Agents Get an Identity, Docs Learn to Talk to Machines, and a 5μs JIT
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: MCP's roadmap gives agents tasks, transports, and DPoP identity; a behaviour study shows coding agents need agent-friendly docs; and LLMs make a database JIT compiler a weekend project. Plus a 100 MB Rust LSP, an empirical edge-AI deployment guide, and Qwen3.8-27B as a local coding agent.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — Agents Get an Identity, Docs Learn to Talk to Machines, and a 5μs JIT

item.title: Decode Daily — Four Models, One Tablet, Zero Permission: Agents Root the Week
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: Frontier agents root a locked Amazon tablet, memory poisoning survives content screening, NGMN maps the interop gaps to autonomous networks, and streaming Japanese ASR lands at 113M params. Kokoro TTS edition.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — Four Models, One Tablet, Zero Permission: Agents Root the Week

item.title: Decode Daily — The Execution Wall: Models Know the Network, but Can't Run It
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: TeleCom-Bench exposes an Execution Wall between what LLMs know about telecom and what they can operate; agents escape sandboxes and code compilers; local inference gets cheaper from a 60 MB model to GPU-free text-to-motion. Plus a binary that is also a SQLite database.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — The Execution Wall: Models Know the Network, but Can't Run It

item.title: Decode Daily — Closed-Loop, Open Minds: Agents Learn to Actually Run the Network
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: NetConfArena makes agents prove they can configure a real network in a closed loop; a QoS broker bridges workflows and B5G/6G slices; OpenAI's Jalapeño chip challenges Blackwell; Qwen ships a 125B/6B-active MoE; an open kernel hits 78k tokens/s on AMD. Plus stealth attacks on multi-agent systems and a single-file graph DB for RAG.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — Closed-Loop, Open Minds: Agents Learn to Actually Run the Network

item.title: Decode Daily — 2026-08-26
item.author: Sarathy
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — 2026-08-26

item.title: Decode Daily — Cheaper by the Token: Sparse MoEs and a 3x Reasoning Shortcut
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: GLM-5.3-Flash brings a 320B/18B-active sparse-attention MoE to open weights; Prefix Sliding makes long-reasoning inference 3x cheaper; semantic routing thinks about the internet of agents; a 110M drafter speeds up Qwen on Apple Silicon. Plus DuckDB stays open under AWS and a parallel linker builds in a fraction of a second.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — Cheaper by the Token: Sparse MoEs and a 3x Reasoning Shortcut

item.title: Decode Daily — Nvidia Buys the Model Mall; the Small Models Move In
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: Nvidia reportedly acquires Hugging Face for ~3B as the open-weights hub gets a new landlord; Terminal-Bench-Science grades agents on real lab workflows; a 2B model gets pretrained on RTX 5090s for under .9K; and small models make their case. Plus privilege escalation in agent harnesses and a 100-terabyte DNS cache win.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — Nvidia Buys the Model Mall; the Small Models Move In

item.title: Decode Daily — Open Weights, Closed Doors: GLM-5.3 Lands as Cursor Loses Its Models
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: GLM-5.3 lands as open weights with a 6x jump on Terminal-Bench 3.0; OpenAI cuts Cursor off after the SpaceX deal; FaulT-Bench grades network-troubleshooting agents on messy tickets. Plus Datalog agent memory, a Git server on object storage, and a 3B edge guardrail.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — Open Weights, Closed Doors: GLM-5.3 Lands as Cursor Loses Its Models

item.title: Decode Daily — Agent Civilizations Rose and Fell; Now the Hall Monitors Are Getting Smarter
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: Three secret agent civilizations rose and fell inside OpenAI's training runs; llms.txt files became a supply-chain attack on coding agents; a provably safe arbiter landed for agentic O-RAN. Plus MoE models that stream from NVMe, a GenAI model on a $1 microcontroller, and the OOXML evidence gap.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — Agent Civilizations Rose and Fell; Now the Hall Monitors Are Getting Smarter

item.title: Decode Daily — Agents Get Physical: PLCs Shaken, Claude Tricked, and SQLite Versioned
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: LLM agents turn PLC access into physical impact in 31.3% of hardware-in-the-loop trials; Claude Code Opus 5 falls to a 60-80% prompt-injection chain; DoltLite ships a Git-style SQLite built with 2,000 agent PRs. Plus SemKV's quality cliff, Pro-Router edge-cloud inference, and Postgres on local NVMe.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — Agents Get Physical: PLCs Shaken, Claude Tricked, and SQLite Versioned

item.title: Decode Daily — Astra Earns the Critical Label; Claude Gets a Fable and a Mythos
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: OpenAI designates Astra its first Critical-capability model for cybersecurity; Anthropic ships Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 with up to 45% cheaper agentic workloads; multi-agent hybrid RAG lands on spectrum intelligence. Plus Apache Iggy graduates, Postgres learns to autoscale, and agents learn to restore power grids.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — Astra Earns the Critical Label; Claude Gets a Fable and a Mythos

item.title: Decode Daily — A Cyber Twin, a Speed Demon, and Mind-Reading 6G Agents
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: Google ships Gemini 3.8 Flash plus a cyber twin for trusted defenders; Inception's Mercury 2.5 generates tokens in parallel at 1,107/sec; and 6G agents learn to model each other's minds. Plus GitSpawn's git-hijack class, structured LLM root-cause analysis for telecom, and Wi-Fi folded into 3GPP slicing.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — A Cyber Twin, a Speed Demon, and Mind-Reading 6G Agents

item.title: Decode Daily — Astra Lands, K2 Opens Its Wings, and KV Caches Learn to Grow
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: OpenAI ships GPT-6 Astra — its flagship with a 1M-token context and a Critical cyber tier; IFM opens K2 Horizon, a six-model Apache-2.0 fleet with a new sparse-attention architecture; Qwen 3.8 27B hits ~1,500 tokens/s on Cerebras. Plus LLMs reasoning over network topology, on-device inference, KV budgeting, and structure-aware retrieval.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — Astra Lands, K2 Opens Its Wings, and KV Caches Learn to Grow

item.title: Decode Daily — The Margin Was Plenty: Claude Proves Fermat's Last Theorem in 11 Days
item.author: Sarathy
item.description: Claude formalizes Fermat's Last Theorem in Lean 4 — 11 days, 13 million lines, and the largest proof ever checked by a computer; an actively exploited Chromium sandbox RCE gets patched; and the agent-infra wave continues with Spotify's 90% token cut, Kubernetes scale-to-zero, and LLMs running in the browser on WebGPU.
item.itunes:title: Decode Daily — The Margin Was Plenty: Claude Proves Fermat's Last Theorem in 11 Days
